name: Youkashi no Haitokuai ~Junshin Tenshi wa Dakarete Iromeku~
original_name: 養花師の背徳愛～純真天使は抱かれて色めく～
source:
“The love you’ve nurtured” is both the sweetest and the most bitter—.

This title is a pure love × cuckold ADV in which you personally train an innocent young girl to become a sex worker and revel in the transgression that awaits her.

As her older mentor, you stay by the side of Sarara Chikamochi, a young lady who doesn’t know her way around, and teach her the basics of sex. This is the “Training Arc,” where you nurture your bond with her.

However, once her training period ends, she will begin working as a “product” designed to please clients.

She’ll offer her body to other men, losing herself to lust and exchanging words of passion…
The “Transgression Arc” follows her as you watch her sensual performances with mixed feelings of fascination and unease.

Her innocent nature remains intact even as she awakens to sexual pleasure. We present an intense psychological portrayal and a sense of excitement, where love, possessiveness, guilt, and a sense of transgression are intricately intertwined.

[Translated from the [url=https://erotica.amusecraft.com/10youkashi//]official site[/url]]
